text: A patient, deeply humane story about hope and friendship. Flawless performances and an ending that earns every bit of its emotion.
The gold standard for the genre: tense, thematically rich, and anchored by an unforgettable villain performance.
A masterful blend of dark comedy, social satire and suspense. Every twist lands; a modern classic.
Electrifying from the first beat to the last. Two ferocious performances and editing as precise as a drum solo.
Monumental world-building, stunning visuals and a thunderous score. A triumph of big-screen spectacle.
Smart, funny and genuinely scary. A razor-sharp thriller that rewards a second viewing.
Two hours of relentless, beautifully choreographed chaos. Practical filmmaking at its absolute peak.
Crackling script and sharp direction turn a small story into a gripping modern tragedy.
Enchanting, strange and endlessly imaginative. Animation does not get better than this.
Cerebral, moving science fiction with a twist that reframes the whole film. Quietly brilliant.
Genre-defining action and big ideas delivered with style. Its influence is impossible to overstate.
An astonishing achievement on every level. I cannot fault a single frame of it.
Perfectly cast, gorgeously shot and emotionally devastating. Essential viewing.
A towering, meticulously crafted historical drama that never loses sight of the human cost.
Razor-sharp dialogue and a playful structure make this endlessly rewatchable.
Ambitious and emotionally sweeping. The science gets hand-wavy near the end, but the scale and heart are remarkable.
Warm and charming with a memorable lead performance, if sometimes a little too sentimental.
A crowd-pleasing finale with huge payoffs for long-time fans, though it is bloated and leans on prior films.
Breathtaking cinematography and a haunting atmosphere. Slow and long, but a worthy, thoughtful sequel.
Vibrant, heartfelt and beautifully animated. Bring tissues for the finale.
A gorgeous, bittersweet love letter to dreamers with a genuinely great final sequence.
Rousing old-school epic filmmaking with a commanding lead. Some historical liberties, but hugely entertaining.
Very strong for most of its running time, with only a slightly rushed third act holding it back.
Confident, stylish and well acted. It does not break new ground, but it is a thoroughly good watch.
An inventive puzzle with spectacular set pieces. Occasionally exposition-heavy, but thrilling throughout.
Funny and surprisingly tender. A few jokes miss, but the cast carries it easily.
Gripping and well paced, with a satisfying payoff despite some predictable beats.
Beautifully made and quietly affecting. Worth seeing even if it never quite soars.
A committed central performance carries a bleak story that feels derivative of better films. Unsettling, but uneven.
Watchable and competently made, though it never really justifies its own length.
Some striking moments stranded in a script that cannot decide what it wants to be.
Perfectly fine. You will enjoy it while it is on and forget it by the weekend.
Half of this works beautifully and the other half does not. Your mileage will vary.
Decent performances in search of a sharper edit. It coasts when it should build.
Neither bad nor memorable; a serviceable time-filler with a few good scenes.
Ambitious but muddled. I admired what it was reaching for more than what it achieved.
Starts strong, sags badly in the middle, and recovers just enough to end on a reasonable note.
An average entry in a crowded genre. Fans will find enough here; nobody else will.
Technically polished and emotionally inert. Hard to hate, hard to love.
Flat, poorly paced and weirdly joyless. The talented cast is stranded with nothing to play.
The plot collapses under its own contrivances long before the ending arrives.
Loud, incoherent and exhausting. Barely a scene lands the way it clearly intends to.
Tonally confused and badly written. Two or three decent images do not rescue it.
A disappointing misfire that wastes a promising premise on lazy execution.
Dull stretches, weak dialogue and a climax that lands with a thud.
It is hard to care about anyone here, which makes the long running time punishing.
Cheap-looking and dramatically inert. I struggled to stay engaged past the first act.
Derivative and predictable, with none of the wit it clearly thinks it has.
An absolute disaster from start to finish. Nothing about this works on any level.
Unwatchable. Incompetently made, painfully acted and genuinely insulting to the audience.
One of the worst films I have ever sat through. Avoid it completely.
Utterly worthless. No story, no tension, no reason for this to exist.
A complete waste of time and talent. I resented every minute of it.
Abysmal in every department. The script is garbage and the direction is worse.
Excruciating. I would rather watch static than sit through this again.
Catastrophically bad. Not even entertaining as a failure.
